application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://doi.org/10.1109/CCNC51644.2023.10060391, p. 1 (Flash Battery lithium-ion packs in AGV applications)

units_released.note: Rule: one row per pack. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.note: Per-cycle aggregate release does not expose pack topology.

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.note: Per-cycle aggregate release has no cell channels.

energy_mwh.note: No pack energy rating is present in the aggregate CSV.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.1109/CCNC51644.2023.10060391, Sec. IV, p. 3 (reset date 1st January 2000, temperatures -40 °C and 215 °C)
sentinels_documented.note: Documented for the fleet data the release is drawn from; the release contains none of them (dates 2019-12-16 to 2022-02-07, temperatures 10 to 48 °C, no missing values; scripts/checks/source_audit/changan_cloverleaf_fei_agv/flashbattery_agv_audit_checks.py). The paper says its data were filtered and missing values imputed; whether the release was is not stated.
